nodes.label: cypher.py — the cypher analysis as a program
nodes.rationale: Section 33: ask each language in turn whether it can speak of an object, and read the answer off the pattern of who answers and who does not.

nodes.label: A language that falls silent is the finding
nodes.rationale: An object every language describes is ordinary; the identity of the silent language names the kind of object.

nodes.label: NOT-RUN is a third state
nodes.rationale: It never prints SILENT for a language nobody ran; register 1172 found five such language/index pairs and the Comparison Audit carries them still.

nodes.label: The degeneracy guard at d = 2
nodes.rationale: At two coordinates pairwise consistency and the cell coincide, so every language agrees for no reason; such a run is DEGENERATE and the agreement verdict is withheld.

nodes.label: The roster is data and the docket is open
nodes.rationale: Dockets 20x-04 and 20x-09 are unruled, so --roster is required and the tool takes no position; under roster 20.2 four of six read NOT-RUN, which is the docket made visible.

nodes.label: PINNED, ADOPTED, DECLARED
nodes.rationale: ADOPTED keeps the provenance of an operator reconstructed from the corpus's pairings plus cited literature and corroborated by reproducing recorded numbers, rather than flattening it to PINNED.

nodes.label: The order operator R, section 32.4.1
nodes.rationale: A monotone staircase closure matching the seated instrument rclose.py; PINNED, and imported by populate.py rather than reimplemented.

nodes.label: K.langclose — E(X) = 0 iff the languages agree
nodes.rationale: Register 1176 read as Beeri, Fagin, Maier and Yannakakis 1983: global and local closures coincide exactly on acyclic structures. A FAILS is a register entry, not a bug to route around; the defect census flags its without-exception as overgeneralisation.

nodes.label: The singleton criterion, section 33.4
nodes.rationale: An index is closed when its output class is a singleton; two outputs mean the observer is still choosing which to read.

nodes.label: Coordinates must be ordinal, and the notation is a coordinate
nodes.rationale: Section 20.3: written as a congruence the parity rule gives E = 750, written spectroscopically the same law is monotone and E = 0. A lexicographic fallback silently changes E, so it warns.

nodes.label: The five, measured rather than declared
nodes.rationale: Operator-bearing is measured by whether a language returned an admitted set. The count survives and the membership does not: statistics is in, analysis is out, and the two special rows are special for different reasons.
